Which phase must be complete by which date

Phase Milestones that carry it Must be complete by What "complete" means On track?
Phase 1 Discovery M0, M1, M2 16 Oct (M2) Current-state and target-vs-current documented; domain/project structure, SSO, and cost attribution designs agreed; foundational spikes decided. On track: all spikes proven; 3 design docs ticketed and in progress (#895, #896, #852)
Phase 2 Foundation M3, M4 28 Nov (M4) Vending and approval/sharing workflows, SSO implementation, catalogue governance, and cost tagging built and tested; Hub catalogue bootstrapped. On track
Phase 3 Pilot M5 18 Dec (M5) Permission model validated on a pilot business unit; pattern library usable by MoJ unaided; per-BU isolation and federated Athena catalogue proven. Not started; the underlying mechanisms are already proven by the spikes

Phase scorecard

Phase Due Progress RAG Assessment
Phase 1 Discovery 16 Oct (M2)
Green On track. All foundational spikes proven. The three design documents are ticketed and in progress (#895, #896, #852) and on schedule; nothing at risk.
Phase 2 Foundation 28 Nov (M4)
On track Not yet due, and ahead of a cold start: the sharing, catalogue and isolation mechanics Phase 2 builds were prototyped live in the spikes. Build can begin in parallel with closing out the Discovery design documents. Watch item is external dependencies (connectivity #780, provisioning contract #779).
Phase 3 Pilot 18 Dec (M5)
Not started Not started, but the underlying patterns (isolation, cross-domain sharing, federated query) are already proven, so the pilot is applying proven building blocks rather than inventing them.

Risks and dependencies

Risk / dependency Likelihood Impact Mitigation and owner
Provisioning interface contract (#779): the integration seam between the provisioning backend and the MoJ frontend/platform. The frontend is not yet mapped, so the contract cannot be fully specified or firmly estimated until that is defined with the MoJ teams. Medium Medium Agree a basic contract (request/response shape, auth, ownership split) now to unblock the build, then refine it once the frontend is ready. Owned by MoJ when the frontend is ready.

Source of truth for tasks: the Justice Data Platform board.

Plan to MVP: sprint goals, gates and the board items behind them

MVP scope (18 Dec): one synthetic domain, one project, discover, request, approve, automatic grant, query, deny, kill switch, audit. Board items are the source of truth; sprints without items yet are refined onto the board at their sprint planning.
